predictor: existing tool-name predictor and unchanged training bootstrap

selection.method: Reserve feasible historical source sessions for cohort A; rank remaining source sessions by seeded SHA-256, allocate ten sources each to B and C and the remainder to A. Within each cohort rank sources and complete eligible segments by seeded SHA-256 and select round-robin. A uses nested N=10/20/30 prefixes; B and C each use one segment from ten sources. Selection uses trace metadata and identifiers only, never policy performance.

measurements: mean session serving time excluding tool waits
whole-workload elapsed time including tool waits
useful-token goodput counting first-use prompt and output tokens once per segment
request throughput, TTFT, P50/P90/P99 and maximum request latency
completed-request token-weighted prefix cache hit rate
server computed-prompt-token counter cross-checked against request usage
first-use prompt tokens and excess computed tokens, retaining alignment/last-token uncertainty
all successful cached-block hash removals during allocation, without sampling
cached-block invalidations outside allocation, separately counted
scope: Runtime-bounded complete-segment adapted replication, not an unfiltered CATraces population estimate. Historical N=10 results remain a separate study because cohort selection and instrumentation differ. No offloading or predictor-training changes are part of this suite.
